skinType.title: How to know your skin type
skinType.summary: Combination, oily, dry, normal or sensitive — discover yours.
skinType.intro: Wash your face with a gentle cleanser and wait 30 minutes without applying anything else.

groups.label: Oily skin
groups.value: shines all over the face, especially in the T-zone (forehead, nose, chin).

groups.label: Dry skin
groups.value: feels tight, may have visible flaking.

groups.label: Combination skin
groups.value: shines in the T-zone but the cheeks stay normal or dry.

groups.label: Normal skin
groups.value: balanced, without excess shine or tightness.

groups.label: Sensitive skin
groups.value: can turn red, itch or react easily to new products.

routineSteps.title: The steps of the Korean routine
routineSteps.summary: The right order: from lightest to heaviest.

groups.label: Double cleansing (night only)
groups.value: first an oil cleanser to dissolve makeup and SPF, then a water-based cleanser for a deeper clean.

groups.label: Toner
groups.value: preps the skin and gives it the first layer of hydration.

groups.label: Essence / serum
groups.value: the treatment step, with the most concentrated actives.

groups.label: Eye contour
groups.value: the thinner skin around the eyes needs specific care.

groups.label: Moisturizer
groups.value: seals in everything you've applied before.

groups.label: SPF (morning only)
groups.value: the last and most important step of the day.

ingredientsByConcern.title: Which ingredients for each concern
ingredientsByConcern.summary: Niacinamide, retinal, vitamin C... what's good for what.

groups.label: Acne / breakouts
groups.value: Niacinamide, BHA (salicylic acid), azelaic acid. Avoid comedogenic oils.

groups.label: Rosacea
groups.value: Niacinamide, centella asiatica, azelaic acid. Be careful with strong retinoids and harsh exfoliants.

groups.label: Dark spots
groups.value: Vitamin C, azelaic acid, and especially consistent SPF.

spfImportance.title: The importance of sunscreen
spfImportance.summary: The step you can never skip, winter or summer.
content: SPF is the only product that truly fights aging: it prevents accumulated sun damage, responsible for most signs of premature aging.
It should be used every day, even if you stay home or the sky is cloudy — UVA rays pass through clouds and glass.
Reapply it if you spend many hours in direct sun; a single morning application doesn't last all day under intense exposure.
spfImportance.warning: If you use retinoids (retinal, retinol), photosensitivity increases. SPF is no longer optional.
